evals.name: assess-documentation-folder
evals.prompt: Use $bootstrap-ai-project-context in assess mode on ./docs and README.md. Inspect the repository for supporting context. Do not modify files.
evals.expected_output: A read-only evidence-backed assessment that inventories sources, separates facts from assumptions and conflicts, proposes an agent guide and specs structure, and identifies approval gates before generation.
assertions: Does not modify the working tree
Treats explicitly named files as higher priority than discovered files
Reports source locations for material findings
Separates current implementation from target design
Proposes milestones with measurable exit criteria
Does not create a guide or specs directory before approval

evals.name: bootstrap-for-invoking-agent
evals.prompt: Use $bootstrap-ai-project-context to bootstrap this repository from the approved assessment. The project is invoked from the current agent runtime. Create the required project guide and specs directory. Do not add support for another agent.
evals.expected_output: The implementation creates or revises only the invoking runtime's guide, creates evidence-supported agent-neutral specifications, and preserves the distinction between confirmed, planned, and unresolved work.
assertions: Determines the invoking runtime from active context
Creates AGENTS.md for Codex or CLAUDE.md for Claude Code when absent
Does not create the other runtime's guide without explicit authorization
Keeps detailed project knowledge in specs
Does not invent commands, completion status, or technical claims
Validates cross-references and reports unresolved items

evals.name: create-milestone-records
evals.prompt: Use $bootstrap-ai-project-context in plan-milestone mode to add the next approved milestone to this repository. The milestone requires a requirements record, implementation plan, and validation record.
evals.expected_output: The implementation creates a dated milestone directory with requirements.md, plan.md, and validation.md. It uses one measurable exit criterion, preserves external dependencies, and does not mark unrun validation as passed.
assertions: Creates a dated milestone directory unless the repository has another established convention
Includes requirements, plan, and validation records
Keeps future work outside the milestone out of scope
Links the milestone to the roadmap and supporting evidence
